_doc: Model and effort per subagent tier (Shay 2026-10-14, revised 2026-10-15 from the 36-run model test). tools/automation/hooks/agent-router.ps1 sets model and effort from here on every Agent call in this project. There is no cascade: no verifier step, no verdict files, no FAIL gates (removed 2026-10-15; one agent on the right model beat cheap-model-then-verify). No Haiku and no Sonnet medium tier. The grade case (kenshi-grader) scores two finished outputs blind and writes a grade file. The bench case takes [model:x] [effort:y] tags. Reasoning and prices: docs/MODEL_ROUTING.md.
